agent.intro: Change or revoke this at any time. Giving Biatec AI more autonomy always asks you to confirm.
agent.modeAnalyzeText: Answers questions, analyzes markets and explains strategies. Never prepares actions.
agent.modePrepareText: Prepares transfers, swaps and other actions as previews in the chat. Every action needs your Confirm before it runs.
agent.modeRuleText: May run eligible actions inside limits you set. Everything else still asks you.
agent.guestText: As a guest Biatec AI can only answer and analyze. Sign in to let it prepare actions for your approval.
agent.pauseText: Answers still work; previews and confirmations are on hold until you resume.
agent.limitsText: Your Biatec OIDC spending limits apply to every action Biatec AI prepares.
agent.limitsPrompt: What are my current spending limits?
agent.limitsNote: Limits are safeguards, not guarantees against loss.
agent.confirmMoving: You're moving from {from} to {to}. Biatec AI will be able to:
agent.confirmResuming: You're resuming Biatec AI in {mode}. Biatec AI will be able to:
agent.powerPreparePreviews: Prepare transfers, swaps and other actions as previews in this chat
agent.powerPrepareConfirm: Ask you to review and confirm each one; nothing is signed until you press Confirm
agent.powerPreparePhone: Ask for approval on your phone where your Biatec OIDC limits require it
agent.powerResumeConfirm: Let you confirm previews that are already open
agent.powerResumeAnalyze: Use its tools again to answer and analyze
agent.confirmAck: I understand I can pause or revoke this at any time, and that limits don't prevent losses.
agent.revokeText: This cancels every open preview and signs you out of Biatec AI on this site. You can sign in again at any time.
agent.saveFailed: The change was not saved. Check your connection and try again.
agent.pausedBanner: Biatec AI is paused. Answers still work; previews and confirmations are on hold.
agent.refusalPaused: Biatec AI is paused, so this action was not confirmed. Resume it to continue.
agent.refusalAnalyze: Biatec AI is set to analyze only, so this action was not confirmed. Change the mode to continue.
agent.toastRaised: Biatec AI may now prepare actions for your approval.
agent.toastRevoked: Access revoked. Open previews were cancelled and you are signed out.
agent.toastRevokeFailed: Sign-out did not finish. Try Sign out again.
